acceptance_criteria.criterion: scripts/build-personas.js reads the has_mcp flag from persona YAML metadata
Generated output for has_mcp: false personas (e.g. 1-planner.md) does NOT contain mcpServers in frontmatter
Generated output for has_mcp: true personas still contains mcpServers: - central_pm
node scripts/build-personas.js --check reports no stale output after rebuild

summary: Updated FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC template in scripts/build-personas.js to conditionally include mcpServers using {{#if has_mcp}}...{{/if}} (same pattern as FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC already uses for mcp_server_name). Previously, mcpServers was unconditionally rendered for all ledger personas regardless of their has_mcp flag.

Rebuilt all personas (node scripts/build-personas.js --suite all): 50 personas across 2 suites × 2 targets built successfully. 1-planner.md (has_mcp: false) no longer has mcpServers in frontmatter. 3-developer.md (has_mcp: true) still has mcpServers: - central_pm.
check mode (--check --suite all) reports all 50 personas as [ok] — no stale output.
All Vitest tests pass: 1518 MCP server tests + 29 persona-helpers tests.

comments.note: scripts/build-personas.js: the has_mcp flag was already present in persona YAML files (1-planner.yaml has has_mcp: false, 3-developer.yaml has has_mcp: true) but was not being used by the build script. This was latent technical debt — the data existed but was silently ignored.

scripts/build-personas.js: the {{#if has_mcp}} pattern is now consistent between FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC and FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC (which already uses {{#if mcp_server_name}} for the same purpose). Unifying the approach to always use has_mcp in both templates would be a cleaner future improvement, but is out of WP scope.

personas/ledger/src/meta: checked all 9 ledger persona YAML files — only 1-planner.yaml has has_mcp: false. All others (2-9) have has_mcp: true. The only output file that changes is 1-planner.md (claude-code). The VS Code output files are unaffected (they don’t have a mcpServers field in their template).

summary: All 4 acceptance criteria verified. 1-planner.md (has_mcp: false) has no mcpServers in frontmatter. 3-developer.md (has_mcp: true) has mcpServers: - central_pm. build-personas.js uses {{#if has_mcp}} guard in FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC template. --check --suite all reports all 50 personas [ok]. Vitest: 1518 passed across 50 test files.

comments.note: The {{#if has_mcp}} guard in FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC is consistent with the existing {{#if mcp_server_name}} pattern in FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC. Unified approach is clean. Developer noted potential future cleanup of the standalone template to also use has_mcp, but that is out of scope.
No issues found — code is clean and consistent with existing build-personas.js patterns. All 50 personas verified in check mode.

summary: Reviewed scripts/build-personas.js FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC template (lines 275-288): the {{#if has_mcp}}...{{/if}} guard is correctly added between the last ccFrontmatterFields() expansion and the closing '---'. Pattern is identical to the {{#if mcp_server_name}} guard already in FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC (line 312). The custom template engine in scripts/lib/persona-helpers.js (line 104) processes these #if blocks using the YAML metadata context object.

Verified generated output: grep for 'mcpServers' across personas/ledger/claude-code/ shows it is present in 2-9 (has_mcp: true) and absent in 1-planner.md (has_mcp: false). Confirmed behavior is correct.

Cross-validated with the persona-helpers.js test suite (line 128-155) which has explicit tests for truthy, falsy, unknown flag, and no-else cases — the template engine handles all edge cases correctly.
All 4 acceptance criteria verified as met. The fix is minimal, idiomatic, and closes a latent gap where the has_mcp flag existed in YAML but was silently ignored by the build script.

comments.note: scripts/build-personas.js: FRONTMATTER_STANDALONE_CC uses {{#if mcp_server_name}} while FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC now uses {{#if has_mcp}}. Both achieve conditional mcpServers injection but use different flags. A future cleanup could unify both templates to use a single flag (has_mcp), making the condition semantically clearer. Low-priority, no action needed now.

The persona build script README or contributing guide should document that the has_mcp YAML field controls mcpServers injection in Claude Code persona frontmatter. This helps persona authors understand why adding a new persona without this flag would omit the MCP server config.
No issues found. The change is correct, minimal, and closes a well-documented latent gap. The existing template engine test coverage provides confidence in the #if processing behavior.
